mentions.name: talmud.dev (online Talmud with AI-enhanced commentaries)
mentions.description: An online Talmud that lets users explore the ancient text in new ways. It blends the classic page format of the text (Tzurat Hadaf) with AI-enhanced commentaries sourced from the classical texts, and aims to help readers better understand the nuance of the ancient text.
mentions.problem: People often completely misunderstand the nuance of this ancient text, usually from antisemitism.
mentions.audience: People studying or encountering the Talmud, including those who currently misunderstand its nuance
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on an online Talmud to explore the old text in new ways! Its been a pet project of mine for over 4/5 years, and to my knowledge its the only attempt to blend the classic format of the text (Tzurat Hadaf) and AI enhanced commentaries sourced from the classical texts
